description: __diff.json parsing (cpp/patch_core/patch_manifest.h ParsePatchManifest), shared by Android, iOS and HarmonyOS. Each vector feeds `manifest` (serialized) or the raw `text`, with `options` (bundlePatchEntryName defaults to index.bundlejs.patch, copySourcePrefix to none). A vector expects either `error` (a substring of the message) or the parsed `copies` ([from, to, crc-or-null] in document order), `deletes` and `hbcTransformMeta` (all three default to empty). `was` records how the platforms disagreed before the parser was shared.
